relationships.subject: prior treatment failures
relationships.evidence_quote: The number of total prior treatment failures was negatively associated with response in all responder rates (25%, 50%, and 75%)

relationships.subject: immuno-rheumatologic disease
relationships.evidence_quote: The existence of immuno-rheumatologic comorbidities negatively affected the CGRPmAb response.

key_findings: In 101 Japanese migraine patients, 54% achieved at least 50% reduction in monthly migraine days after 3 months of CGRPmAb.
Older age positively, and prior treatment failures and immuno-rheumatologic history negatively, predicted response.
